Body.Content: Build highly scalable and responsive applications with Azure Redis Cache, a distributed, in-memory, managed cache based on the popular open-source Redis Cache. It gives you super-fast access to your data, is highly secured, managed by Microsoft, and is accessible from any application in Azure. Azure Redis Cache is available in the Azure Preview portal during public preview.
Body.Markdown:
Build highly scalable and responsive applications with Azure Redis Cache, a distributed, in-memory, managed cache based on the popular open-source Redis Cache . It gives you super-fast access to your data, is highly secured, managed by Microsoft, and is accessible from any application in Azure.

Azure Redis Cache is available in the Azure Preview portal during public preview.
